summary.text: Laura Sibilia is an independent state representative from Vermont's Windham-2 District who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her background is in economic development.

paragraphs.text: Laura Sibilia lives in Vermont and earned an associate degree in hotel and restaurant management from Champlain College in 1990 and a bachelor's degree from the Massachusetts College of Liberal Arts in 1996.

Her career experience includes working as a waitress, reporter, director of the Mount Snow Valley Chamber of Commerce, and regional economic development professional at the Brattleboro Development Credit Corporation.

Ballotpedia lists Sibilia's 2023-2024 committee assignments as vice chair of the Energy and Technology Committee, vice chair of the Information Technology Oversight Committee, vice chair of the Judicial Rules Committee, the House Ethics Panel and the Joint Legislative Child Protection Oversight Committee.
